description: API #13: Audit candidate resumes against RFP Section L/M Key Personnel and GSA MAS / OASIS+ / Alliant 3 Labor Category (LCAT) qualification requirements (years of experience, degree equivalency substitutions, security clearances, DoD 8570/8140 certifications), rewrite experience into Shipley Key Personnel bio & bullet citations, and generate a ready-to-sign Letter of Commitment (LOC).

candidate_resume_text.description: Candidate's raw resume, CV, security clearance level, certifications, education, and work history.

lcat_or_rfp_requirements.description: Raw RFP Section L/M Key Personnel requirements, GSA LCAT minimums, clearance mandates, and DoD 8570/8140 certification criteria.

name: match_key_personnel
